use_cases: Interactive background for hero or landing page sections
Visual accent for contact forms or pricing pages
Decorative animated element for creative portfolios
Background effect for SaaS product pages
ai_summary: A canvas-based animated component that renders vertical bars with procedural noise-based wave animation. Features mouse tracking for hover influence and click-triggered ripple effects. Fully customizable with props for background, line, and bar colors, line width, and animation speed. Primarily used as an interactive decorative background element for modern web interfaces.
